Seller Notes

2026 Acura Integra A-Spec Tech Package in striking Platinum White Pearl with Ebony perforated Ultrasuede seating. This liftback delivers engaging performance with a 1.5L I4 engine and 6-speed manual transmission, achieving EPA-estimated 26 city / 36 highway MPG. Actual mileage may vary. With just over 9,800 miles, this is a practically new opportunity to own precision engineering. - AcuraLink Connected Services - ELS Studio 3D Premium Audio System - Heads-Up Display with Lane Keeping Assist System - Adaptive suspension with 18" aluminum-alloy wheels - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration - Heated front bucket seats - Power moonroof 182 Point Inspection, Roadside Assistance, $0 Warranty Deductible, Transferable Warranty, Vehicle History, Limited Warranty: 24 Month/100,000 Mile (whichever comes first) after new car warranty expires or from certified purchase date, Powertrain Limited Warranty: 84 Month/100,000 Mile (whichever comes first) from original in-service date, 1st Scheduled Maintenance is Free, Complimentary 3-month AcuraLink trial, Complimentary 3-month SiriusXM Radio Service. Includes Trip Interruption, Rental Vehicle Reimbursement and Concierge Service. Experience the blend of sporty handling and modern technology. Schedule your test drive today and discover why Acura Precision Certified vehicles stand apart.
